mission.name: Imazu 05 -- head-on + crossing from starboard (2 targets)
mission.own_ship_role: mutual (both alter to starboard) to ts1 / give-way to ts2
mission.description: Canonical Imazu problem 5, reproduced from Sawada et al. (2021) Table 4 (J. Mar. Sci. Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 approaches head-on; ts2 crosses from starboard (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship alters course to starboard (not port) for the head-on target(s).
Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
